title: Pre-diagnosis plasma cell-free DNA reveals early signatures of prostate and breast cancer risk up to eight years prior to clinical detection.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: paper_context.py: Europe PMC has no full text, no PMCID, no supplement, no accession numbers (only two antibody/software RRIDs), no Zenodo/Dryad hit. Fetched the 2023 medRxiv preprint XML (same cohort, breast-only version): its Data Availability says data are 'available from the corresponding author on reasonable request'. Web search found the Ontario Health Study (OHS) runs a formal data access application process.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 491 samples after quality control (171 incident breast cancer, 93 incident prostate cancer, 227 cancer-free controls), cfMeDIP-seq (methylated DNA immunoprecipitation sequencing) profiling, hazard ratios 3.55 and 2.3 — from the abstract and news coverage only. The final Cell Genomics data statement was not read (publisher page not scraped, per project rules); no EGA (European Genome-phenome Archive) or GEO deposit was found.

a1_downloadable.note: No public deposit found anywhere. Preprint says data are available on reasonable request; the samples come from the Ontario Health Study, which requires a data access application. Human cohort data, so controlled access at best.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked in files. Case/control status and time to diagnosis would be per-sample columns from registry linkage, per the paper.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not checked; no files accessible. Inputs would be per-region methylation counts derived from raw sequencing.

a5_enough_rows.note: Paper reports 491 samples (classification task, above the ~400 bar), but not verified in files.

a6_fits_laptop.note: If only raw cfMeDIP-seq reads were shared, working set would be hundreds of GB; no processed matrix is known to exist publicly.

a8_label_provenance.note: Labels are cancer registry diagnoses (Canadian Cancer Registry linkage) — a real clinical outcome, not a model output, per the paper.

honest_claim_h3: Would predict future breast/prostate cancer diagnosis among Ontario Health Study volunteers from one cfMeDIP-seq lab, but the data cannot be obtained without an access application.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use blood DNA methylation patterns from healthy people to predict who will be diagnosed with breast or prostate cancer years later.
plain_idea.train_on: Methylation levels across genome regions in cell-free DNA (DNA fragments floating in blood plasma) from 491 people per the paper; count not verified.
plain_idea.predict: Whether the person was later diagnosed with breast or prostate cancer, and how soon, taken from linkage to the Canadian cancer registry.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Early cancer screening groups would gain a blood-based risk marker years before diagnosis; but the data are not publicly accessible.

ml_idea: Classify future cancer cases versus controls from cell-free DNA methylation region counts; not pursued because the data require an access request.

effort.cheapest_killing_check: Find a public deposit (EGA/GEO) of the processed methylation matrix — none found.

verdict_reason: A1 fails: human cohort cfDNA data from the Ontario Health Study have no public deposit; the preprint states 'available on reasonable request' and OHS requires a data access application (controlled access).
